narrative: WETA's existing service is the spine. Navier is framed as a right-sized electric layer for targeted frequency, published expansion and closer waterfront endpoints that can reduce first/last-mile friction. Marin terminals are Golden Gate Ferry context and inter-agency candidates only.
claim_status_rule: Verified facts may be stated. Company-reported metrics are labeled. Candidates and future paths remain visibly qualified. Unsupported values and bindings remain null.
